title: Jurisdictional Pin Simulation Playbook for Sales Engineering
summary: Working playbook for running jurisdictional pin simulations used by Sales Engineering during pre-sales validation and operator tabletop drills. Focuses on sandboxed eviction/rollback scenarios, evidence capture for legal/compliance, and customer-facing messaging templates.
audience: Sales engineering, solutions engineers, operator oncall, pre-sales legal reviewer
objective: Provide a compact, reusable checklist and runnable scripts for demonstrating region pin behavior, simulating emergency rollback/eviction, and packaging telemetry so legal/compliance can verify locality outcomes quickly.
scope: Sandboxed runs only (non-prod). Tests cover: region pin enforcement, fallback routing to alternate data-region, tenant pin migration simulation, evidence collection for audits, and customer comms templates. Not covering persistent data migration or long-term eviction workflows.
quick_steps: 1) Provision isolated sandbox tenant with region pin set to EMEA (use sandbox account)
2) Seed traffic using synthetic trace generator with 3 user profiles and varied sequence lengths
3) Trigger controlled capacity constraint to force fallback routing (short-enough request flood)
4) Run operator rollback script to simulate pin eviction and capture logs/trace IDs
5) Collect evidence bundle: request traces, region headers, infra routing decisions, and storage access logs
6) Validate evidence against compliance checklist and generate customer-ready summary
test_scenarios: Pin-enforced: Verify every request from pinned tenant is routed to EMEA hosts and storage with latency < 200ms in sandbox region
Fallback-route: Simulate EMEA pool OOM and ensure automatic fallback goes to 'nearby' region (EU-west -> EU-north) NOT to US region
Eviction-rollback: Simulate administrative eviction of pin and confirm that subsequent requests can be routed to multi-region pool and KV cache invalidation is visible
Cross-border leak check: Run traffic with malformed geo header to verify system rejects or tags requests that claim mismatched origin
Telemetry-loss simulation: Disable agent on one edge and confirm evidence still contains routing decision and queued events are annotated
operator_commands:
# start sandbox generator
./tools/sim-traffic --tenant sandbox-pin-123 --region eu --users 3 --qps 15 --seq-dist short,med,long

# force fallback by consuming EMEA capacity on pool 'eu-prod-sim'
./infra/consume-capacity --pool eu-prod-sim --gpu 4 --duration 90s

# run rollback (dry-run flag available)
./ops/pinctl rollback --tenant sandbox-pin-123 --confirm --dry-run

# collect traces by request id list
./telemetry/export --request-ids <comma-list> --format ndjson --out /tmp/evidence
evidence_requirements: Storage access logs showing region and bucket/cluster target
Service-level trace with sampling context and fallback reason code
Operator audit log entry for manual actions (who, when, justification)
Signed manifest (sha256) of packaged evidence and generation script version
customer_message_snippets: Short note for technical contact: We ran a sandbox simulation showing pin enforcement behavior. Evidence bundle attached with request traces and routing summary. Happy to review live.
Non-technical exec summary: We validated your pick of EU region pin. All sandbox requests remained in-region unless an engineered fallback was triggered. See attached one-pager.

If we need to evict temporarily: We propose a phased migration with 24–48h notice, usage snapshot, and acceptance test window. This simulation demonstrates the rollback path and evidence we will provide.
open_questions: Do legal/compliance need signed timestamps from HSM for evidence manifests? (action: ask Legal)
What SLA/notice does Sales want to promise customers for emergency pin rollback? (action: align with GTM)
Should we add a canned demo script for on-call to run during customer workshops? (action: prioritize)
Is there appetite to store evidence bundles in customer-visible S3 under escrow for audits?
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sandbox simulations accidentally touch prod credentials. Mitigation: enforce RBAC tokens and explicit sandbox-only env vars.
Risk: Evidence incomplete due to sampling. Mitigation: temporarily raise trace sampling during simulation window and document sampling rate.
Risk: Customer misinterprets 'fallback' as data exfil. Mitigation: clear script and demo narrative explaining routing vs data movement.
